episodes.title: From Cult Survivor to Coach: Writing as a Path to Healing with Alexandra Amor
episodes.description:
What does it take to turn the hardest chapter of your life into a career built on helping others heal? In this episode, Matty Dalrymple talks with Alexandra Amor, who spent ten years in a cult in her twenties before leaving and spending decades making sense of what had happened to her. 

Alexandra shares how the disconnect between what a group preached and how it behaved became the signal that something was deeply wrong, why she turned to psychological and sociological research to understand her experience, and how that research eventually became an award-winning, best-selling memoir. She talks candidly about the difference between being taught and being led, why cult survivors often don't realize they're in a cult until well after they leave, and how writing her story became the foundation for a second career coaching other survivors and independently published authors. 

The conversation also covers what Alexandra looks for before saying yes to a podcast interview, the value of speaking in “sound bites” without losing your humanity, and why she believes creativity, more than expertise alone, is what helps people heal after trauma. Whether you're interested in the psychology of cults, the process of turning a difficult personal story into a book, or practical tips for showing up well as a podcast guest, this conversation offers something valuable.

Alexandra Amor coaches cult survivors who want to tell their stories in writing. She began her writing career with an Amazon best-selling, award-winning memoir about ten years she spent in a cult in the 1990s. She is also The Self-Publishing Coach, helping writers to publish their books while avoiding the scams and hassles.
 
Matty Dalrymple is the author of the Lizzy Ballard Thrillers, beginning with ROCK PAPER SCISSORS; the Ann Kinnear Suspense Novels, beginning with THE SENSE OF DEATH; and the Ann Kinnear Suspense Shorts. She is a member of International Thriller Writers and Sisters in Crime. More at mattydalrymple.com. Matty also writes, speaks, and consults on the writing craft and the publishing voyage, and shares what she’s learned on THE INDY AUTHOR PODCAST. She writes nonfiction books for authors; her articles have appeared in Writer’s Digest magazine; and she is a Partner Member of the Alliance of Independent Authors. More at theindyauthor.com. She also guides professionals in building their presence through a sideline or second act through her platform From Expertise to Authority. More at theindyauthor.com/authority.
